\section*{Question 1}

Let \(f\) and \(g\) be the functions given by \(f(x)=e^{x}\) and \(g(x)=\ln x\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the area of the region enclosed by the graphs of \(f\) and \(g\) between \(x=\frac{1}{2}\) and \(x=1\).
\item[(b)] Find the volume of the solid generated when the region enclosed by the graphs of \(f\) and \(g\) between \(x=\frac{1}{2}\) and \(x=1\) is revolved about the line \(y=4\).
\item[(c)] Let \(h\) be the function given by \(h(x)=f(x)-g(x)\). Find the absolute minimum value of \(h(x)\) on the closed interval \(\frac{1}{2} \leq x \leq 1\), and find the absolute maximum value of \(h(x)\) on the closed interval \(\frac{1}{2} \leq x \leq 1\). Show the analysis that leads to your answers.
\item[(a)] Area \(=\int_{1 / 2}^{1}\left(e^{x}-\ln x\right) d x=1.222\) or 1.223
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Volume } & =\pi \int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}\left((4-\ln x)^{2}-\left(4-e^{x}\right)^{2}\right) d x \\
& =7.515 \pi \text { or } 23.609
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)] \(h^{\prime}(x)=f^{\prime}(x)-g^{\prime}(x)=e^{x}-\frac{1}{x}=0\) \(x=0.567143\)
Absolute minimum value and absolute maximum value occur at the critical point or at the endpoints.
\[
\begin{aligned}
& h(0.567143)=2.330 \\
& h(0.5)=2.3418 \\
& h(1)=2.718
\end{aligned}
\]
The absolute minimum is 2.330.
The absolute maximum is 2.718.
\end{itemize}
